title: Calendar App
description: Build a calendar application that calculates days in months, builds a calendar grid, highlights dates, and supports month navigation.

steps.title: Calculate days in a month
steps.description: Write a `getDaysInMonth` function that takes a `year` and `month` (1-12) and returns the number of days in that month. Account for leap years.
hints: Months with 31 days: Jan (1), Mar (3), May (5), Jul (7), Aug (8), Oct (10), Dec (12)
February has 28 days, or 29 in leap years
Leap year: year % 4 === 0 && (year % 100 !== 0 || year % 400 === 0)

codeTemplate.python:

print(getDaysInMonth(2024, 2))
print(getDaysInMonth(2025, 2))
print(getDaysInMonth(2025, 1))

verification.successMessage: getDaysInMonth correctly handles all months including leap years!
verification.failureMessage: Feb 2024 should return 29 (leap year), Feb 2025 should return 28, Jan 2025 should return 31.

steps.description: Write a `getFirstDayOfMonth` function that takes a `year` and `month` and returns the day of the week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ..., 6 = Saturday) for the first day of that month.
hints: Use the Date object: new Date(year, month - 1, 1).getDay() in JS/TS
In Python, use: from datetime import date; date(year, month, 1).weekday() (Monday=0) or .isoweekday()
Return the numeric day of week value

codeTemplate.python:

steps.title: Build the calendar grid
steps.description: Write a `buildCalendarGrid` function that returns a 2D array representing weeks. Each sub-array contains 7 entries (dates), with 0 or null for padding days outside the month.
hints: Get the first day of week and days in month
Create an array of rows (weeks), each with 7 columns (days)
Fill days from 1 to daysInMonth, pad with 0 before and after

verification.successMessage: Calendar grid is built with proper week rows and padding!
verification.failureMessage: buildCalendarGrid should return a 2D array with 7 columns per row, using 0 for padding days outside the month.

prevMonth: if month === 1, decrement year and set month = 12; else month--
Log: 'Navigated to: <month>/<year>'
